title: feat(react-instantsearch): provide codemods to help with migration
body:
**Summary**

### [FX-2390](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2390)

**Result**

Refer to the [README](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/feat/react-instantsearch-codemods/packages/react-instantsearch-hooks/scripts/transforms/README.md) to see what each script does.

Instead of publishing it as a package, we could simply mention in the docs that the scripts can be downloaded with `curl` or `wget` so that it can be reviewed and changed, `addWidget-to-addWidgets` was not published either.

Few limitations are :

* `defaultRefinement` can't really be handled as the script is ran file by file, so I decided to just add a TODO comment
* If a `translations` object or `showMore`, `page` or `ariaPage` are not defined inline, it's not easy to modify so we just add a TODO comment as well
* Code is a little hard to read, I could perhaps look into migrating to TypeScript if it's worth it
